title: Official Elderheim Pack
description: A lightweight client-side pack for performance and quality-of-life improvements, perfect for Elderheim or general play.
body:
![elderheim logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d5808de20689dc138634b1dff89e331e590edd6.png)
-
An **optional client-side enhancement pack** for Minecraft that improves:

- ⚡ **Performance**  
- ✨ **Visual & UI clarity**  
- 🧭 **Quality-of-life features**

Designed to be a lightweight upgrade for your client, with **no gameplay content changes** and **no server-side requirements**.

Perfect if you want to enhance your experience on **Elderheim** — or simply make Minecraft feel smoother and more modern in general.
